desc: Experience unlimited shooting lanes with this 360 ? Swivel action seat and bench top. 12 wide x 14 deep x 2 thick seat provides ultimate comfort, while the 29 square bench top with extended arm rests and padded vinyl cover provide all day comfort while shooting. Two shell/gear pouches are an added feature with an adjustable, coated gun-rest to accommodate any hunter. Weight rating is 300 lbs. And bench weighs 38lbs.
